recommendations.title: Study recommendation rules
recommendations.description: Configure suggestions on the learner dashboard. Uses the last 30 days, up to 100 attempts per source; requires enough evidence before identifying a weakness.

recommendations.saveError: Could not save. Check the values or retry.
recommendations.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Save before leaving to keep them.

recommendations.prioritizeDue: Always rank due vocabulary before other sources
recommendations.sourcesHint: Uncheck to disable a source. Priority 1 ranks first. Disabling every source removes activity suggestions.
recommendations.invalid: Enter values within the allowed ranges before saving or previewing.
recommendations.simulated: Simulated data only, with no personal history lookup. Preview uses the current form without saving.
recommendations.disabled: Recommendations or all sources are disabled.

mistakes.title: My mistake notebook
mistakes.description: Mistakes from completed activities. New results may appear after synchronization. Marking as reviewed does not change scores or SRS schedules.

mistakes.unavailable: This content is no longer available.
mistakes.noExplanation: No explanation is available for this item yet.
mistakes.adminDescription: Top 20 content items by error rate in the last 30 days. Aggregated statistics only, with no personal history lookup.

mistakes.adminEmpty: No content has enough samples to publish statistics yet.
mistakes.practiceUnavailable: This activity is currently unavailable for practice. You can still review the completed result.

publication.savedOnly: Validate and preview the saved version. Content edits return it to draft.

publication.actionError: The action failed. Reload and validate the latest content.

contentQuality.title: Data quality
contentQuality.description: Review missing data, media and potential duplicates. Results come from the last completed scan; opening this page does not scan the catalog.
contentQuality.loadError: Unable to load results. Please retry.
contentQuality.scanError: Unable to queue a scan. Please retry.
contentQuality.queued: Scan request received. Progress updates automatically.
contentQuality.stale: No fresh snapshot within 24 hours. Rescan when needed.
contentQuality.workerError: Scan did not finish after 3 attempts. Previous results remain available. Check source services and rescan.
contentQuality.noFeedback: No learner content-report source is available yet. This tab will aggregate reports when that feature is integrated.
contentQuality.noScan: No completed scan yet. Select Rescan to check content.
contentQuality.empty: No warnings in this category in the latest scan.
contentQuality.mediaScope: Only system media URLs are probed, at most 4 per batch. External or unavailable URLs are marked unverified, not confirmed dead.
